author: Icy_Negotiation6868
body:
All starting classes are viable the entire way through, some classes are hidden until later levels/unlocked through quests. Pick what feels natural and fits your aesthetic. But also be aware you can chnage at any time for a small orn fee, which is a secondary currency that is found alongside gold.

Your first 150 levels will go by very quickly, so dont bother over upgrading your gear to9 much as you will be switching it out pretty often until tier 9 (200+)

There's are 3 types of activity you will see while out and about, dungeons which are floor to floor, these can look different and have different themes depending on events or sometimes just cause

Monuments which are floor exploration type dungeons that end in a boss fight (they also reward an hour long buff upon completion) these are great fir early experience points

And towers which become available when you hut tier 9, they are special but not something you need to worry about right now

For the first 100 or so levels you should focus on defeating things on the map, equipping gear and setting up your home base (usually where you live)
